subject.title: fix(security): add default pidsLimit for sandbox containers

question: Should OpenClaw make a positive Docker sandbox `pidsLimit` the default for existing unset configs, and what opt-out contract is required before that ships?
rationale: The mitigation addresses a real Docker sandbox resource-exhaustion gap, but it changes effective runtime behavior for existing configurations and needs security-owner approval.

options.title: Approve default with upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the default-on PID cap only after schema/type/docs/tests and real Docker proof cover fresh installs, upgrades, and explicit override semantics.

options.title: Preserve unset behavior
options.body: Close or rework the branch so operators opt into `pidsLimit` while docs recommend hardened values.

options.title: Use an opt-in strict path
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved strict profile or setting if maintainers want hardening without changing existing unset deployments.

recommendation.title: Approve default with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Keep the default-on PID cap only after schema/type/docs/tests and real Docker proof cover fresh installs, upgrades, and explicit override semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the affected sandbox runtime and security-doc surfaces to this team.
